title_en: Rescheduling a meeting with a colleague

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Hi Tom, have you got a minute? It's about Thursday's project review.

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Something's come up with a client, and I won't be able to make the 2 p.m. slot. Would it be possible to push it back to Friday morning?

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Friday morning is a bit tight for me, but I could do 11. Does that work for you?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: 11 works perfectly. I'll send out an updated invite to the team.

dialogue.speaker: Tom
dialogue.en: Great. Could you also circulate the slides beforehand so everyone can take a look?

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Will do. I'll get them out by Thursday afternoon at the latest.

expressions.zh: 「临时有事」。come up 指事情突然发生，用来委婉说明改期原因。
「赶得上、能参加」；slot = 排好的时间段。
把时间往后推、推迟（提前是 bring it forward）。
「谢谢你提前告诉我」。heads-up = 提前打的招呼或提醒（口语）。
